from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, tempfile
from factoryline.external_evidence import import_external_runtime_bundle
from factoryline.graph_ops import graph_ops_snapshot
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='factory-triage-'))
artifact = root / 'runtime.txt'
artifact.write_text('failed\n', encoding='utf-8')
bundle = root / 'bundle.json'
bundle.write_text(json.dumps({'schema': 'factory.external-runtime-bundle.v1', 'provider': 'testsprite', 'project_id': 'triage-project', 'test_id': 'triage-test', 'run_id': 'triage-run', 'snapshot_id': 'triage-snapshot', 'code_version': 'triage-commit', 'environment': {'fingerprint': 'triage-env', 'label': 'local'}, 'verdict': 'failed', 'failure_kind': 'assertion', 'first_failed_step': {'index': 1, 'label': 'submit'}, 'hypothesis': 'persist failed', 'recommended_fix': 'inspect transaction', 'artifacts': [{'path': 'runtime.txt', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'kind': 'runtime-log'}], 'observed_at': '2026-08-24T12:00:00Z'}), encoding='utf-8')
import_external_runtime_bundle(root, bundle, 'testsprite')
snapshot = graph_ops_snapshot(root)
assert snapshot['recommendation']['action'] == 'review_external_runtime_failure' and 'GRAPH_OPS_EXTERNAL_RUNTIME_TRIAGE_READ_ONLY' in snapshot['markers'] and (snapshot['authority']['execution'] is False)
